Method of Attack: Information-stealing malware that collects cookies, saved passwords, credit cards from web browsers (Google Chrome, Yandex, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, Brave, Vivaldi), Steam and Discord info
Searches for documents containing 'password' in filenames and other credentials including local Windows login and Telegram
Installs itself as a Windows Boot Manager application in the AppData folder or as UnityLibManager in the /AppData/Roaming folder
Uses token hijack to compromise Steam and Discord accounts to upload malicious updates
Deployed via compromised Steam update system of Downfall fan expansion
Impacted Systems: Web browsers: Google Chrome, Yandex, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, Brave, Vivaldi
Attack Vector: Compromised Steam and Discord accounts of Downfall developer
Malicious update pushed through Steam update system for Downfall fan expansion
Token hijack to gain control of Steam and Discord accounts
Indicators of Compromise: Unity library installer popup during launch of Downfall on 12/25/2023 between 1:30 PM-2:30 PM Eastern
Malware installed as Windows Boot Manager application in AppData folder or as UnityLibManager in /AppData/Roaming folder
Malicious upload replacing Downfall packaged game
Reports of malware installing itself silently and stealing credentials
